issue.body:
Stepping with a debugger into/through `Request.url_for` (used with templates) shows that it does a lot of `try/catch`, and processing in general.

I think it would make sense to use `functools.lru_cache` with it.

Is this out of scope for Starlette itself, and should apps do their own caching instead?
issue.title: Use LRU cache?
